alice_rl: Kicking off staged rollout for inference-api v2.17.0-rc3 -> 5% traffic now. Change window: 2026-03-20 22:00-23:00 UTC. Asking ops for quick health thumbs up.
deploy-bot: [deploy] Started rollout: inference-api v2.17.0-rc3 -> segment=5% (ids: seg-742). Canary instances: 4 pods in eu-west. CI: green. Release notes link: https://internal.redwood/release/2.17.0-rc3
ben_oncall: Looking at metrics — I'll watch p99/p95 and error-rate for the next 10m. ETA to call: 10m. @alice_rl any pinned fallback version?
alice_rl: fallback is v2.16.4 (pinned). If we see >1.5x p95 or errors >0.5% for 5m we hold and pin traffic back.
carmen_pm: Small note: release notes mention model quantization tweak; watch embedding accuracy testset run id: embed-eval-332
zoe_devex: Quick sanity: double-checked deploybot args. rollout strategy: linear by region, preferring euro first. Autoscaling policy unchanged.
deploy-bot: [metrics-snapshot] seg-742 initial 2min: p95=92ms, p99=210ms, errors=0.08%.
tom_runtime: Saw one KV cache eviction warning on one canary node ~2m ago but no OOMs. Logging: `kvcache: evict 1 entries, mem=78%`.
ben_oncall: p95 creeping to 140ms last minute, p99 320ms — that's ~1.5x baseline. errors stable. Holding observation window 5 more minutes before calling hold/go.
alice_rl: Let's wait the 5m window. If p95 stays >=1.4x or p99 >300ms for >3m we call HOLD and rollback to pinned v2.16.4. @tom_runtime can you check per-model latency (openai-gemini-v2 equiv)?
tom_runtime: Checking model-specific traces: tokenizer latency up ~30ms on small shard (eu-west-2). Kernel selection fallback triggered once on 1 host. Patching kernel selector now, should be quick.
deploy-bot: [update] Applied transient kernel-selector override to canary hosts. Retrying warmup. New warmup tokens primed.
ben_oncall: After override: p95 down to 95ms, p99 215ms, errors 0.09%. Looks stabilized. I'd vote GO.
alice_rl: Consensus: GO to continue ramp to 20% over next 30m. No pin/rollback. Zoe please update the release notes channel with the kernel-selector note.
zoe_devex: Will post short note: "Applied kernel-selector tweak during canary; monitoring latency. No customer-facing impact." :white_check_mark:
carmen_pm: Also kicking off embed-eval-332 run against production-shaped traffic; will report regressions if >0.5% drift.
ben_oncall: I'll keep an extra watch for autoscaler flapping during the ramp. Ping if anything odd.
alice_rl: Thanks team — ramping to 20% now. Marking this thread closed unless issues crop up. :rocket:
